categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Yuxing Film Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of special functional polyester films. Its main product categories include electronic optical polyester films, photovoltaic polyester films, electrical insulation polyester films, textile yarn polyester films, and power battery polyester films. The company also extends into precision coating processing through its subsidiary, focusing on electronic and new energy materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced biaxially oriented polyester film (BOPET) technology with proprietary dual-stretch thick film processes. It operates a dedicated functional polyester film technology R&D center equipped with pilot polymerization, extrusion, and multilayer co-extrusion systems. The firm emphasizes continuous innovation through collaborations with Zhejiang University and Changzhou University, focusing on polymer film synthesis, coating technologies, and functional polyester masterbatch development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are brand enterprises in downstream industries such as consumer electronics (LED, LCD backlight modules, electronic protective films), photovoltaic solar panels, electrical insulation for motors and transformers, textile machinery, and new energy power batteries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong focus on supplying first-tier brand supply chains in electronic optical and photovoltaic sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province, China, with operations primarily serving the domestic Chinese market, which accounts for over 95% of revenue. It also has a growing export business targeting overseas markets, contributing around 4.6% of total sales. The company leverages the Yangtze River Delta industrial cluster for supply chain and logistics advantages.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Yuxing operates mainly in the midstream segment of the polyester film supply chain, producing functional polyester films from polyester chips sourced from upstream suppliers. It also extends downstream by supplying coated films and functional materials to end-product manufacturers in electronics, photovoltaics, and electrical insulation industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-performance, differentiated, and multi-variety functional polyester films, especially targeting electronic optical applications. R&D efforts focus on developing products such as OCA optical adhesive films, matte high-temperature resistant films for automotive applications, polarizer protective films, environmentally friendly flame-retardant films, and ultra-low density reflective films. It also emphasizes digital transformation, production line upgrades, and strengthening collaborations with academic institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of polyester film products to industrial customers, with a smaller portion through distributor channels. The company also earns income from coating and processing services via its subsidiary. Pricing is contract-based, negotiated with customers, and revenue is recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Yuxing is one of the largest domestic producers of special functional polyester films in China, holding leading market shares in photovoltaic backsheet films, electrical insulation films, and power battery films. It competes with both domestic and international players, including Japanese and Korean manufacturers who dominate high-end functional polyester film segments. The company is actively working to reduce reliance on imports by enhancing R&D and product quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.1 billion, a 34.75% decline from the previous year, primarily due to reduced demand in photovoltaic polyester films. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 357 million. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 3.63 billion with equity of RMB 2.28 billion. Despite short-term challenges, it is investing heavily in capacity expansion and product upgrades, with a focus on sustainable growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Yuxing emphasizes high-quality, functional, differentiated polyester films tailored to meet specific customer needs in high-tech industries. Its competitive advantages include proprietary technology, strong R&D capabilities, a broad product portfolio covering multiple industrial applications, and close collaboration with leading brand customers. The company aims to break import monopolies in high-end segments and provide innovative, environmentally friendly, and high-performance polyester film solutions.
